je-name.label: Rajasthan Royals' longest-serving player
je-name.dataset: CricField warehouse: Cricsheet IPL ball-by-ball data, 2008–2026
je-name.filters: Seasons batting or bowling for the franchise
je-name.query: SELECT pl.name, COUNT(DISTINCT x.y) seasons, MIN(x.y) first, MAX(x.y) last FROM ( SELECT CAST(CASE m.season_id WHEN '2007/08' THEN '2008' WHEN '2009/10' THEN '2010' WHEN '2020/21' THEN '2020' ELSE m.season_id END AS INTEGER) y, d.batter_id pid FROM deliveries d JOIN innings i ON i.innings_id = d.innings_id JOIN matches m ON m.match_id = d.match_id WHERE i.innings_number <= 2 AND i.batting_team_id IN (10) UNION SELECT CAST(CASE m.season_id WHEN '2007/08' THEN '2008' WHEN '2009/10' THEN '2010' WHEN '2020/21' THEN '2020' ELSE m.season_id END AS INTEGER) y, d.bowler_id pid FROM deliveries d JOIN innings i ON i.innings_id = d.innings_id JOIN matches m ON m.match_id = d.match_id WHERE i.innings_number <= 2 AND i.bowling_team_id IN (10)) x JOIN players pl ON pl.player_id = x.pid GROUP BY pl.name ORDER BY seasons DESC, pl.name

je-share.label: Share of Rajasthan Royals' runs scored by those players
je-share.dataset: CricField warehouse: Cricsheet IPL ball-by-ball data, 2008–2026
je-share.query: SELECT pl.name, SUM(d.batter_runs) runs FROM deliveries d JOIN innings i ON i.innings_id = d.innings_id JOIN players pl ON pl.player_id = d.batter_id WHERE i.innings_number <= 2 AND i.batting_team_id IN (10) GROUP BY pl.name
